index: Consumer Price Index, all items (2022 = 100), Somalia, as the IMF's Consumer Price Index dataset (IMF.STA:CPI) carries it: the Somalia National Bureau of Statistics' Mogadishu index to December 2024 and its new CPI from January 2025, linked into one series
note: Monthly: each year's mean is of its twelve months, the IMF's values as its API gives them (read 30 October 2026). The Somalia National Bureau of Statistics replaced its Mogadishu index (December 2014 = 100, to December 2024) with a new CPI from January 2025 (index reference 2022, all states) and publishes no link between the two. The IMF's dataset carries one monthly series on 2022 = 100 from 2020 to July 2026 joining them; who made the link, and how, the dataset doesn't state (its sources: 'Country Authorities; ... IMF Staff Calculations'). The owner ruled on 30 October 2026 that the IMF-linked series stands for Somalia ("Yes, use the IMF-linked series for Somalia.").
